plan: To prioritize capital preservation, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, MSFU, PLTU) to zero.
This significantly reduces your true leverage and exposure to high-beta assets.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to cure the concentration breach and reduce broad market exposure.
The focus is on income and broad index funds for stability.
This plan aims for a large cash buffer for safety.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for a more stable portfolio. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: This balanced approach focuses on risk-first growth by trimming high-beta and leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, PLTU, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 25% to cure the concentration breach.
The goal is to reduce overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech and broad indices.
A moderate cash buffer will be maintained.
This plan balances growth potential with risk management.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, aiming for growth with a strong emphasis on risk management. It reduces leverage and concentration, blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and a more controlled drawdown compared to aggressive modes.

plan: This aggressive plan trims SPY to 25% to cure the concentration breach.
It then leans into high-conviction scanner setups by buying NVDD at 6% of the book.
Leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL will be added to 5% each, pushing into higher-beta sectors.
This strategy aims to maximize growth by concentrating in strong setups and using leverage.
A smaller cash buffer will be maintained, accepting higher risk.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretched growth by leveraging high-conviction setups. It embraces higher concentration and uses leveraged ETFs, which can lead to significant drawdowns and daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage the amplified risk.

plan: This income plan sells all high-beta and leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, PLTU, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to reduce concentration and free up capital.
QQQI will be significantly increased to 30% to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
The focus is on low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
A cash buffer will be maintained for stability.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and capital preservation. It significantly reduces exposure to high-beta and leveraged assets, focusing on income-generating ETFs. While aiming for low drawdown, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market downturns.
